models_evaluated: Locally developed AI duodenal biopsy classifier

links.outcome: Reporting turnaround time with AI-prioritised queue vs routine pathway
links.effect: Coeliac disease reported in 6 vs 10 days; non-neoplastic abnormalities 7 vs 10 days (both p<0.005); neoplastic lesions not reported quicker.
links.quote: In the AI triage workstream coeliac disease, and non-neoplastic abnormalities as a group, were reported quicker than in the standard workstream (6 days vs 10 days and 7 days vs 10 days, respectively, both p<0.005), but neoplastic lesions were not reported quicker.
